description:
Permanently delete a time entry you own (managers can delete anyone's). Entries of a delivered budget are locked. An entry of another organization returns not_found. Available only on accounts with Time Tracker enabled.

Cost: 2 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// delete one entry by id.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","entry":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"}
```
name: delete_time_entry

render_with.description: Render tool that can display this payload.

title: Delete time entry
